basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old gamer from Seattle who recently got into the world of Monster Hunter. I work as a part-time barista and spend my free time exploring new games and connecting with other players online. I love RPGs and action games, especially those with rich lore and challenging gameplay. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to dive deep into my hobbies. I usually browse Reddit during the evenings after work or late at night when I can't sleep. Outside of gaming, I'm interested in music and occasionally attend local concerts and shows.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of Monster Hunter games, which I developed by watching YouTube tutorials and engaging with the community on Reddit. My gaming experience is mostly self-taught, as I've been playing video games since I was a kid. My recent dive into Monster Hunter World has been a rewarding challenge, and I've learned a lot through trial and error.
